prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_visibility_setup", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_visibility_setup": {"headline": "Calibrate Pet Desktop Space", "body": "Ensure display overlay permissions and multi-monitor coordinates are active before your pet steps onto your screen.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "plain", "text": "Desktop overlay layer enabled"}]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Companion Trait & Audio Voice Match Selector Redesign: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live sound previews and personality trait cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Personality & Voice", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "pet_choices", "style": "playful", "text": "Energetic Buddy vs Gentle Companion"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Playground Flow: Add an interactive mini-tutorial flow on the home introduction screen to practice pet voice commands, hiding gestures, and quick controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Try Your First Pet Commands", "body": "Practice calling, hiding, and talking to your new pet right now.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "home_welcome", "text": "Practice Voice Call, Practice Hide Shortcut, Practice Mood Reaction"}]}}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Finalize Pet Save Sign-In Placement: Move sign-in to the absolute end of onboarding after home_intro, framing account creation as saving your existing pet's memories.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet to Your Account", "body": "Sign in now to store your pet's personality, memories, and items permanently."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Previous Pet Restore & Sync Prompt: Add an explicit helper prompt on the sign-in screen informing returning users that logging in restores existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already adopted a pet before? Sign in with your original email to restore your pet instantly."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Diagnostic & Display Hardware Indicator: Display real-time animation engine loading status and graphics shader initialization steps on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Animation Engine", "body": "Building graphics shaders, window transparency, and custom pet movement paths."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Path Time & Effort Transparency Copy: Clarify time commitments on the path choice screen (Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet Creation).
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "body": "Choose Instant Adoption for a ready-to-play companion (30s) or Custom Creation to design from scratch (2 mins).", "button_label": "Continue Choice"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Welcome Starter Item Adoption Reward: Display a founder badge reward on the adoption certificate screen upon finalizing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered! Complete setup to unlock an exclusive Founder Pet Toy.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "playful", "text": "Bonus Unlocked: Free Founder Toy"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background Generation Desktop Audio Alert: Enable an optional chime and desktop notification when generation finishes while the window is minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this app. We will chime when your pet is ready on your screen."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Visual Introduction Layout: Switch the introductory story screen layout to a story scroll presentation showcasing interactive pet moments.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Meet Your Screen Companion", "body": "A living desktop pet that plays, listens, and brightens your workspace every day."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid new desktop setup screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps.
Redesigns the pet selection screen while maintaining the core job of letting the user choose a pet.
Adds an interactive practice flow within the home_intro screen inside onboarding.
Reorders sign_in to after home_intro, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adds a sign-in prompt for returning users without introducing dark patterns or extra data requests.
Updates waiting screen visuals while continuing to show that the pet is being prepared.
Adds time transparency to path choice while keeping both adoption and custom pet creation options.
Mentions a 'Free Founder Toy' extra, violating the prohibition against mentioning free extras or gifts in onboarding copy.
Adds an optional notification setting on the waiting screen without altering external settings.
Redesigns the story screen to a scroll layout while fulfilling its job of introducing the pet.
